Name: Fish Squid Time Machine
Overview:
"Fish Squid Time Machine is scary and loud. Also the controller often vibrates. I hear that's called rumbling.

There is a donkey. I'm not sure why. I have heard that you control the fish squid, but this is not readily apparent." - Lan , doesn't play games, age 30.

FSTM interbreeds the Fishie Fishie and SYNSO series. Each button controls a different player.
